reason: NONE. The first thing I noticed was 30 little foil packets and the $29.99, and it feels like a lot of trash and a lot of money for something I'd forget to take half the time anyway. On my budget I'd grab a cheaper bottle of magnesium before I'd spend $30 on a fancy box.
objection: $29.99 is too much for me for one supplement, and all those single foil packets feel wasteful.
would_change_my_mind: A price around $15 to $18 for the box, or a cheap trial size, like a 7 sachet sample, so I could see if it even helps me sleep.
